transcript: Now I know there's a whole agenda that delivery drivers are just lazy and we don't actually want to work for our money but on the other hand we have to deal with stuff like this. I was making this delivery and the note from the customer said that basically the building entry is fob only so there's no code. So basically what I have to do is just wait outside till a car drives in and just sneak in behind them. What? So that means if a car does not show up I don't get to go in I just gotta sit outside and then what happens but luckily i'm here to make money so I didn't do that. I just went through the front door of the leasing office and walked around the building and just dropped it off. I mean. And this is why I say to accept every order with the value up front and not try and gamble for extra tips or anything like that. Because you never know. We ain't here to gamble. We're here to just make some money.
